eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Control & Communication (ICICCC-2026) aims to unite researchers and professionals to explore advances in intelligent computing, secure systems, data-driven technologies, and modern communication networks. The conference covers next-generation data communication, networking architectures, AI and expert systems for intelligent automation, and emerging methods in machine learning and deep learning. It also focuses on data and system security, including cryptography, cybersecurity, blockchain, and resilient system design. The IoT and data analytics track highlights big data processing, cloud/edge intelligence, smart sensing, and IoT-enabled applications. ICICCC-2026 promotes interdisciplinary collaboration and provides a platform for innovative solutions that drive the development of smart, secure, and efficient technologies for future digital ecosystems.
